cases.description: Thickness stated in a complete sentence: 1.2 cm vs recorded 1.2 mm -> propose 12.0 mm.
cases.limitation_note: Line-based candidate passage regex expects an immediate delimiter (':', '=', or 'is') followed directly by the number; descriptive sentences containing interstitial phrases (e.g. 'is manufactured to 1.2 cm') fail candidate extraction.
cases.explanation: Evidence unit 'is' is unsupported. Only ['cm', 'mm'] are supported.

cases.description: Thickness represented in table with separate parameter, value, and unit columns: 15.0 mm vs recorded 15.0 cm -> propose 1.5 cm.
cases.limitation_note: Multi-column table cells are extracted by pypdf as individual separate lines ('Thickness\n15.0\nmm'). Line-by-line scanning cannot correlate the attribute name with values and units located in subsequent table lines.
cases.explanation: No measurement passages found for attribute 'thickness' in matching document(s).

cases.description: Thickness label and measurement split across lines: 2.4 mm vs recorded 2.4 cm -> propose 0.24 cm.
cases.limitation_note: Retrieval splits extracted page text strictly on newlines and processes each line in isolation. When an attribute label and its numeric measurement are wrapped across a newline, neither line individually matches candidate extraction.
cases.explanation: No measurement passages found for attribute 'thickness' in matching document(s).

cases.description: Thickness listed alongside length and width: thickness is 6.0 mm vs recorded 0.6 cm -> values agree, no_change.
cases.limitation_note: Candidate passage regex matches the nearest numeric token following 'thickness' (which matches the adjacent length '60.0 mm' after the closing parenthesis). As a result, the pipeline extracts the wrong dimension (60.0 mm instead of 6.0 mm) and proposes an incorrect correction (6.0 cm) instead of no_change.
cases.explanation: Supplier document specifies 60.0 mm, which converts via deterministic arithmetic to 6.00 cm (60.0 mm * 0.1 cm/mm = 6.00 cm). Recorded value is 0.6 cm. Proposing correction to 6.0 cm.

evidence.supporting_passage: Package dimensions (length, width, thickness): 60.0 mm x 40.0 mm x 6.0 mm.

cases.description: Datasheet has revision B while record specifies revision A -> return insufficient_evidence.
cases.limitation_note: Expected behavior: Revision guardrail correctly identifies revision mismatch and safely abstains with insufficient_evidence.
cases.explanation: Document content matches component 'COMP-C05' but revision 'A' was not confirmed.

cases.description: Two conflicting thickness statements (0.8 cm and 1.2 cm) in the same document -> return ambiguous_evidence.
cases.limitation_note: Expected behavior: Ambiguity resolution guardrail detects multiple distinct thickness measurements and safely abstains with ambiguous_evidence.
cases.explanation: Conflicting measurement values found for 'thickness': 0.8 cm, 1.2 cm.
